description: Create a word search puzzle URL. You must provide the list of words (no hints needed). The list must have between 3 and 30 words. If user specifies count/topic, generate appropriate words first, then call this tool with the words parameter.

allow_special_characters.description: Optional: Allow accented/special characters in the grid instead of stripping them to plain letters.

language.description: Optional: Language for the word search. Use the same language as the prompt. Please use ISO 639-1 codes: en, es, fr, de, pt.

topic.description: Optional: Topic/theme for the word search. Only for reference.

word_count.description: Optional: Number of words requested (3-30). Only for reference/validation.

words.description: Plain list of words, one per line, separated by newlines. Must contain 3-30 lines. Each word must be 3-20 letters long. Non-alphabetic characters do not count towards length. Words do not need to be uppercased.

name: create_word_search
